description:
## Goal

Give the remaining private Enum list walkers the exact source-owned domains they consume, removing the controlled no-matching-clause warnings without wildcard suppression or activation-derived contracts.

This is runtime-library work associated with the active fz-lib / PR #122 arc, not a recalculator dependency. Rebase the warning census against the accepted PR #122 head before implementation.

## Acceptance

The named map/filter/flat-map/concat/map-reduce/scan/intersperse/map-join helpers retain Elixir-owned output on every door and emit no listed warnings. Exact schemes preserve element, callback, accumulator and result correlation; genuine user partial functions still warn. Delete obsolete diagnostic goldens and update runtime-source documentation.
title: Declare exact domains for the remaining Enum private list walkers
